attempts.equivalence_review: Authenticated exact frozen bundle 5b16185f631726b59f3218a4334b4e8d2baf97b9 with Bundle validation; used its G3 reference and brief, not mutable working-tree knowledge. Full graph inspection: exactly one each of g3-power-input-header, g3-rail-filter, g3-reference, g3-thermistor, g3-photodiode, g3-adc, g3-rs485 and mounting-holes. Every full parameter object, port contract and instance requirement equals the reference; graph requirements return_paths, guard_keepout and sensitive_nets retained. No extra electrical instance or connection. input_power binding: input_terminal.VIN, rail_filter.VIN and rs485.VDD share only the direct external rail. Resolved pins include input header J1.1, ferrite FB1.1, RS485 U1.8 and its supply/bias feed. External source is 3.2–3.4 V, 150 mA; ADC host header does not export this supply. analog_supply binding: rail_filter.VOUT, reference.VIN, photodiode.VDD and adc.VDD share the filtered rail. Resolved ferrite FB1.2 supplies MCP6002 U1.8, ADS1115 U1.8, their decoupling and three parallel reference-bias resistors. The 3.1994–3.4 V, 10 mA engineering model is unchanged; RS485 is not moved onto it. reference_signal binding: reference.VREF, thermistor.VREF, photodiode.VREF and adc.AIN_REF share the reference, including TL431 U1.1 cathode and U1.2 REF, both divider feeds and ADS1115 U1.6. No cathode capacitor or substituted direct-rail ADC reference measurement. Independent signal bindings: thermistor.OUT reaches only ADS1115 AIN0 pin4; photodiode.OUT reaches AIN1 pin5; reference reaches AIN2 pin6. No swapped channels or joined analog outputs. ADC address pin1 and unused AIN3 pin7 are grounded. common_return binding includes all seven electrical blocks. Full resolved ground includes MCP6002 pin4, TL431 pin3, ADS1115 pin3, SN65HVD75 pin5, photodiode anode, NTC lower lead, connector grounds and decoupling returns. No split ground or isolated return. Compared the entire expanded intent against frozen reference after explicit bijective instance/net renaming: all fields identical except the graph serialization hash, including all42 components and exact parts/footprints, all20 physical net pin partitions, BOM, all60 layout constraints, evidence/dependencies, fab profile, mechanical and manufacturing requirements. Thus comparison was not only counts or six binding checks. Independent final expansion against authenticated bundle gives EXPANDED, no refusals and all62 checks PASS. Parameters retain 100 kHz I2C with 50 pF model, ADS1115 8 SPS and ±4.096 V range, and 115200 bit/s RS485 with compatible remote negative receiver threshold, two120-ohm ends and only one bias pair. Reference and supply budgets retained and independently checked: reference resistor equivalent minimum330 ohm gives maximum feed(3.4−2.35)/330=3.181818 mA; with TIA2 mA and ADC3 mA total8.181818 mA remains below10 mA filtered-rail budget. Minimum reference cathode current(3.1994−2.65)/(1010/3)−0.5mA=1.131881 mA. Modeled reference load including10 uA ADC scenario is about0.3091 mA, below0.5 mA allowance. RS485 remains separately supplied within150 mA source budget. Analog design unchanged: NTC10k/3977-K model over15–35 C with10k series/100nF filter; dual MCP6002 half-reference buffer and10k feedback TIA with four22pF capacitors, BPW34 cathode at summing input and anode ground,100nF+10uF supply bypass. Explicit50uA photocurrent and50mV aggregate error scenarios remain engineering assumptions, not source-guaranteed accuracy. Physical intent retained: driven BIAS guard around SUMMING, continuous common-ground return constraints, thermistor thermal keepout, compact ADS/ferrite pads and four M3 holes. A1/A2 electrical equivalence does not establish routed guard/return realization, A3–A6, hardware stability or radiometric accuracy; ADC typical loading, adopted ferrite DCR-temperature behavior and ideal first-order loop model retain their stated limitations.
